title: Sunday · Twenty Years
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The arc's Sunday: the cafeteria from the beach road at dusk, its windows lit for something, the 1997 grid drawn faint under the paint of the first tier, a man and a pup on the road, and the corn at Gully's in the last with twenty flyers behind it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the high school cafeteria's windows lit at dusk from the beach road, and beneath the watercolor, faint, the 1997 strip's four-panel grid showing through.

image.prompt: a school cafeteria's lit windows at dusk seen from a beach road with a faint four-panel comic grid showing through beneath the watercolor, no words

panels.name: Faint

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man and a small three-legged dog on the beach road, stopped, looking at the windows.

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog stopped on a beach road at dusk looking toward lit windows, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Road

panels.composition: Tier 3: Gully's counter, a tray of corn, and behind it through the door the wall with twenty flyers.

image.prompt: a paper tray of buttered corn on a wooden counter with a shingle wall of many paper flyers visible through a door behind, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Corn

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Twenty. The grid under the paint.
